text:
Ana (PM): Heads up team  were preparing the launch kit for the Inference Spotlight webinar. Core asks: a hero micro-GIF (1200x628) + MP4 fallback, three benchmark card templates (800x800 square, 1200x628 banner) that cover latency vs cost, throughput vs quality, and memory-efficiency tradeoffs. Need Figma components, export presets, README with naming conventions, alt text examples, and two contrast-safe palettes (brand + high-contrast). Also include short A/B copy variants (headline, one-line tech blurb, CTA) and localization for JP/FR/DE. First drafts targeted Tue EOD. @Ravi @Sora @Marta

Ravi (Design): Got it. I can mock both an animated-sparkline hero and a frame-by-frame metric transition hero; will optimize GIF sizes and include MP4 H.264 loops. Question: prefer embedded sparkline animation or subtle per-metric pulses? GIF size implications differ. I can supply both as separate assets (small GIF + higher-quality MP4).

Marta (Growth): Include a simple routing manifest so each asset can tag inbound leads to the right webinar cohort (UTM + cohort id). I'll need filenames to follow a predictable pattern so the landing page can auto-assign cohort metadata.

Sora (L10n): Quick timeline note  I need final English master copy by Mon 6pm PST to turn around JP/FR/DE. JP CTAs need shorter character counts (mobile ~12-18 chars). If copy changes after that well need to push localization.

Ravi (Design): I'll build a Figma file with a dedicated "EXPORTS" page, components with named layers (for CSV-driven swaps), and an accessibility checklist: alt text templates, WCAG contrast ratios, and keyboard-focus fallback suggestions for animated elements.

Ana (PM): Also add a QA checklist for brand compliance (logo lockups, minimum clearspace, correct font weights), plus a forbidden-swatch list and legal review flags. Pair each card variant with suggested copy pairings (headline + 1-line).

LegalBot: Reminder: Be cautious with the term "free" in EU markets. All EU-facing copy should be routed to legal@redwood.ai for sign-off prior to final export.

Ravi (Design): Placeholder Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/launchkit-mock (placeholder)  I'll replace with the real file. Export presets to include: GIF low/med/high, MP4 short-loop (H.264), PNG 1x/2x, and a CSS sprite fallback recommendation.

Ethan (Ops): Marta, can you post the minimal JSON routing manifest so I can confirm our webhook schema? Ill wire it to the registration flow and webinar cohort creation.

Marta (Growth): Minimal manifest example:```json
{"utm_source":"newsletter","utm_medium":"webinar","utm_campaign":"spotlight_apr2026","route":"/webinar/spotlight","cohort":"apr2026_spotlight"}
```Use this pattern in the README so ops can map filename -> UTM template.

Ravi (Design): Proposed filename template: `redwood_launch_{assetrole}_{variant}_v{semver}_{lang}.ext` e.g. `redwood_launch_hero_spark_v1_en.gif` or `redwood_launch_card_latency_v2_fr.png`. I'll document this in the README and include an assets manifest JSON mapping file -> UTM template.

Sora (L10n): Note about FR/DE  watch for long compound nouns. Ill provide condensed translations and a note where layout truncation may be needed. I'll also supply alternative CTAs for JP to fit tight layouts.

Ravi (Design): I'll also prepare a grayscale print variant and a single-color partner silhouette. Plus a microtile template (Figma component + named text layers) that non-design folks can swap numbers into using CSV import plugins or a small export script. README will include a tiny Node snippet showing CSV -> PNG export using Figma API or a headless Puppeteer example.

Marta (Growth): One more request: include UTM placeholders in asset metadata (e.g., in the README manifest) so the marketing page can auto-populate the campaign params. Also add an example mapping filename -> utm template.

Ravi (Design): Delivery plan: Tue noon PST  Figma first-pass (mock + components). Wed EOD  localized assets + README + routing manifest. If Legal review delays, final exports may slide to Thu.

Ana (PM): Great. Please tag me when the Figma is live. CC DesignOps for storage path. :pray:

DesignOps: Storage note  once final add to shared folder `marketing/webinars/2026-04-spotlight-launchkit`. Ensure file permissions allow comment-only for external reviewers.

Ravi (Design): Adding checklist entries to the Figma README now: export presets, alt text samples, aria-label guidance, contrast checks, legal flags, localization constraints, and the assets manifest. Will ping when first pass is uploaded. :thumbsup:
